主要内容: Berkery Noyes released its 2011 Mergers & Acquisitions report for Private Equity in the Information Industry, analyzing activity in 2011 compared to 2009 and 2010. The report highlights six deals exceeding $1 billion, with GoDaddy.com's $2.25 billion acquisition being the largest. Vista Equity Partners led in transaction volume with 19 deals, nine in Q4 2011. Apax Partners had over $2.5 billion in transaction value, with three of the top ten deals by value. The report notes a 16% increase in total transaction volume from 336 in 2010 to 389 in 2011. Berkery Noyes Managing Partner John Shea noted a 20% average annual growth in deal value and volume over three years, suggesting an improving economy. Notable transactions include Golden Gate Capital's acquisition of Lawson Software and Bain Capital's acquisition of MYOB Limited. Berkery Noyes specializes in M&A advisory services for the $25 million to $500 million range, combining strategic research with IT banking expertise. The report is available on Berkery Noyes' website.
